input: How did Tata Consumer foods, salt, and Sampann grow in the quarter?
context:
In terms of Foods, we had a 6% volume growth, 14% revenue growth. Salt grew 13% with 5% 
volume. Actually, we have achieved our highest -ever quarterly tonnage . Value -added salts 
continued their strong momentum, up 31%. Sampann has grown 27%. And most importantly

expected_output: Tata Consumer foods grew 6% in volume and 14% in revenue. Salt grew 13% with 5% volume and reached its highest quarterly tonnage. Value-added salts were up 31%, and Sampann grew 27%. Newer Sampann lines such as dry fruits and cold pressed oil kept growing, with the business tracking an ARR of about INR200 crores.
